summary: A retro style shoting FPS & RPG game. It's rich in content and addictive!
description:
1. Introduction:
        This is a fun and cool indie game, players will play as a shooter (can choose 3 occupations) to adventure in ancient tomb and dungeon, explore treasures, obtain weapons and props, constantly improve the ability of themselves and their pets, and challenge the more and more powerful monsters, I believe you will find your own fun.
        On the basis of FPS games, it's combines the characteristics of RPG and AVG, and contains many original contents, which are not only unique and interesting, but also very playable, bringing players a brand new gaming experience.
        This game adopts a realistic dark style and has a strong sense of immersion. It may feel scary in some scenes. It is recommended that players over 18 years old download it.

2. Featured Content Introduction:
        A. Forgotten Temple - This is an independent game mode, in the dark underground, a large number of monsters are attacking the temple, you can use vertical perspective to guard the defense tower with pets, and you will get rewards after success.
        B. Death Cave - In the two chambers of the cave of death, you will play the devil's prey, evading the hunt from the darkness, when you collect 3 gems, the devil will be weakened.At this time, after killing the demon, rare items will be dropped. Very exciting!
        C. Undead Arena - Compete with the zombies of the arena boss with your pets and get high value rewards after winning, but you can't help much when the pets are fighting.
        D. Treasure hunt - There are many treasures buried in the dark ancient tombs, they are guarded by ferocious monsters, many explorers have died trying to get the treasures, can you succeed?

3. Description of some elements:
[DNA] Defeat bosses 2, 5, 10, and 21 to have a chance to drop their DNA.
[Blessing of Snakes] Gives pet snakes the ability to suck blood and increase defense.
[Darkness] The gun has a chance to fire black bullets, causing 200-300% damage.
[Treasure Identification] Increases the probability of obtaining treasure when opening a treasure chest.
